name: seam: the body's own reader takes keep from a line said without being asked, false when the line has none, an offer when a line carries one (its button's words and the words it sends), a go line with its address and name, and the words of a typed line

lines.text: This is the date to keep: the application closes in 8 days.
Open Deadlines to see the dates.
November 22 is open in your calendar.
Room bookings are on the RSO Resources page.

out: took say(id: "g1", beat: 0, text: "This is the date to keep: the application closes in 8 days.", aside: false, trail: Optional(["saw this page", "found 1 date"]), keep: true, offer: nil)
took say(id: "g2", beat: 0, text: "Open Deadlines to see the dates.", aside: false, trail: Optional(["saw this page", "found where it is"]), keep: false, offer: nil)
took say(id: "t1", beat: 0, text: "November 22 is open in your calendar.", aside: false, trail: nil, keep: false, offer: nil)

took say(id: "t2", beat: 0, text: "Room bookings are on the RSO Resources page.", aside: false, trail: nil, keep: false, offer: Optional(ParalBody.Offer(label: "Open RSO Resources", send: "take me to RSO Resources")))
took go(id: "t3", url: "https://campusactivities.usc.edu/rso-resources/", label: Optional("RSO Resources"))
took typed(text: "add it to my calendar")
